thread:
AI Agent Memory in Production: Postgres, Redis, Vector Search, or All Three?

Quick thread 🧵
AI agent memory splits into three jobs.
Short-term context (the last few turns) fits in the prompt window and caches nicely in Redis.
Durable history and user preferences are your record of truth and belong in Postgres.
Long-term recall across past chats and documents needs embeddings and vector search, which pgvector handles right inside Postgres.
